experiment.hypothesis: masked local feature prediction from surrounding context may localize defects better than clean reconstruction at the same 48x48 grid

masking.coverage: exactly once per patch; 25% per group

training.head: Conv3x3(1536->256)-GroupNorm-GELU-Conv3x3(256->256)-GroupNorm-GELU-Conv1x1(256->1536, groups=2)
training.loss: per-group mean cosine distance at masked positions; equal group weights; clean target detached
training.c1: clean input, same head/loss positions, test error at all positions
training.m1: masked input at token entrance, same head/loss positions, test only at each position's masked pass

metrics.mask_source: exact original 448->392 gt transform, nearest to 256
metrics.primary: full-test pooled pixel AP (P-AP); class macro mean
metrics.per_image: P-AP-image: mean within class of per-image AP on valid anomaly images, then class macro

deviations: Masked features are recomputed on the fly once per image per epoch instead of cached: four masked patterns per image would need ~13.6 GB float16. Clean targets are cached as float16 .npy and reused as C1 input, which is memory bounded.
C1 is scored at all 48x48 positions from one clean pass; M1 is scored only at each position's own masked pass, as specified.
The original 448->392 top-1% image score is reported separately; per-variant image metrics use each variant's own map top-1%.

Two condition-specific heads with identical architecture and identical initialization are used rather than one head updated by both conditions; joint updates would confound C1 and M1. Within each condition the head is shared across both feature groups.
AdamW with weight_decay=0.0 is used; the plan fixed only seed, epochs, learning rate and masks, so no extra regularization was introduced.

identity.b0_geometry: original -> Resize(768) -> CenterCrop(672) and original -> Resize(448) -> CenterCrop(392); both to 256 with bilinear+gaussian(5,4)
identity.mask_geometry: 48x48 grid; 4x4 blocks; four parity groups; each patch exactly once; 25% per group
identity.masking_entrance: encoder token embedding before any attention block (prepare_tokens masks=)

pooled._note: pooled pixel AP across all 494 test images; pooled P-AUPRO is omitted because the full-size region computation is prohibitive, per-class P-AUPRO is reported
